entries.content_plain: PSALM 98 Psa 98:1-9 . In view of the wonders of grace and righteousness displayed in God's salvation, the whole creation is invited to unite in praise. 1. gotten ... victory-- literally, "made salvation," enabled Him to save His people. right hand, and ... arm-- denote power. holy arm-- or, "arm of holiness," the power of His united moral perfections ( Psa 22:3 ; 32:11 ).
